title: Web credibility elements and commercial pressure
statement:
In a large quantitative study of web credibility, elements conveying real-world presence, ease of use, expertise, trustworthiness, and tailoring increased perceived credibility, while commercial pressure and amateurish presentation reduced it. (DOI)

Options:
- Real-world presence: real_world_context_block (fits: established, transparent)
- Working product evidence: product_ui_evidence (fits: technical, pragmatic)
- Named expertise: expert_attribution (fits: authoritative, expert)
- Role-specific tailoring: role_specific_path (fits: focused, customer led)
appliesWhen: Applies to: consumer websites, high consideration digital products. Audience: adults, general.
